title: crew project config
description: Optional per-project config for the crew plugin hooks, read from <project>/.claude/crew.json. Without the file the hooks use their defaults, and spec-first does nothing. A malformed file is ignored.

baseBranch.description: Branch that spec-first compares against, as origin/<baseBranch>. When that ref is missing and a local branch of that name exists (a project with no remote), the local branch is used. With neither, the hook does nothing.

managerModel.description: The model the copied feature skill pins for the turn it runs in. When absent, the copy carries no model line and each contributor's session model applies.

updateWorkflow.description: When true, crew-vendor also copies a weekly GitHub Action (.github/workflows/crew-update.yml) that proposes crew updates as a pull request. When false or absent, the workflow is not copied, and one that crew-vendor wrote earlier is removed on the next apply.

protectedBranches.description: Branches that guard-destructive protects from force-push, deletion and (through an upstream) plain push. Entries that are not plain branch names are dropped. An empty or invalid list falls back to the default.

confirmProtectedPush.description: When false, guard-destructive no longer asks for confirmation before a push to a protected branch (an explicit one such as git push origin main, or a bare git push whose upstream is protected). Force pushes, +refspec, --delete and :branch on a protected branch stay denied. Any other value keeps the prompt.

specFirst.description: Spec-first nudge. Without this block, or without at least one valid root and one source extension, the hook does nothing.

mode.description: nudge, shadow, enforce or off (case-insensitive, any other value behaves as shadow). The CREW_POLICY_MODE environment variable wins when set and not empty.

ruleFile.description: Project file that explains the rule. Named in the nudge and in the enforce message when set.

path.description: Directory relative to the project root, for example services/core/src. Must stay below the project (no ..).

moduleDepth.description: Number of directories below the root that name a module. A test must be touched under the same module as the edited file. 0 makes the whole root one module (a flat source folder). With 1 or more, files with fewer directories than this below the root are not gated.

sharedModulePattern.description: Extended regular expression matched against the first directory of the module. A module that matches is a cross-cutting layer: a test anywhere under the root satisfies it.

testRoots.description: Extra directories, relative to the project root, where a test file also counts, for a test/ or tests/ folder next to the source root. Searched whole, whatever the module of the edited file. Entries that climb out of the project (..) are dropped.

sourceExtensions.description: Extensions of files that are gated, for example .ts. Other files under a root are never gated.

testPatterns.description: Basename globs of test files. They are never gated, and one touched under the module satisfies the rule. Patterns must not contain a slash.

ignoreRegex.description: Extended regular expressions tested against /<module>/<rest of path>. A match is never gated. Added to the built-in ignores: test, fixture and mock directories (fixtures, tests, __tests__, __fixtures__, __snapshots__, __mocks__) and *.fixture, *.fixtures, *.e2e-fixture, *.mock, *.stub and *.test-utils files.
